en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large statue of a man in military uniform standing on a tall stone pedestal in a landscaped area with low plants in the foreground. The figure wears a long coat and a spiked helmet, standing with hands on hips. The pedestal bears the inscription "ALBERT" on its side. In the background to the right is a two‑story building with typical Central European architecture and some faint signage on its facade; trees and a low wall are visible to the left.
